description: Clozemaking-style exact input/output rules for automatic whole-frame Resolve. Every case is production prompt calibration and an exact regression; known-wrong post-images locate adjacent semantic boundaries.

rules.title: Read the complete frame
rules.invariant: Every Issue and edit is selected from the complete frozen Memory frame even when only some Memories are mutable.

rules.title: Default target removes NO
rules.invariant: Ordinary Resolve may finish at MAY or YES; it should not force unsupported precision merely to obtain YES.

rules.title: Strict target requires YES
rules.invariant: A YES-targeted Resolve may publish only a post-image independently judged YES; an evidence-preserving MAY repair is not enough.

rules.title: Use exact supplied grounding
rules.invariant: When supplied Memories state the missing time, scope, exception, identity, or transition, make the smallest exact edit that expresses it.

rules.title: Express a safe alternative locally
rules.invariant: When descriptive claims can safely remain alternatives, add OR or alternative meaning with the smallest exact grammatical edit instead of weakening every claim with MAY.

rules.title: Do not invent a discriminator
rules.invariant: Do not fabricate weekdays, locations, audiences, causes, precedence, or other facts merely to separate incompatible claims.

rules.title: Do not choose by order
rules.invariant: Memory order, UID, wording length, or edit convenience never makes one unsupported claim authoritative over another.

rules.title: Stop unsafe action choices
rules.invariant: Do not turn mutually exclusive directives, recipients, permissions, amounts, or destructive targets into an OR that authorizes an arbitrary consequential action.

rules.title: Preserve unaffected facts
rules.invariant: Keep every unrelated condition, exception, time, audience, and Memory byte-for-byte unchanged.

rules.title: Do not delete merely to Fit
rules.invariant: Resolve must preserve competing information through an exact relation or transition edit; making Fit easier is never by itself a reason to delete a Memory.

rules.title: Check the exact post-image
rules.invariant: Independently judge the complete exact post-image and publish no partial effects when it misses the requested Fit target.

cases.description: Two unqualified descriptive times become one explicit alternative through one local edit, without inventing a schedule discriminator.

effects.after: The office opens at 9 as an alternative to opening at 8.

result: The office opens at 8.
The office opens at 9 as an alternative to opening at 8.
expected.reason: One relation-bearing edit preserves both recorded times and leaves their applicability unresolved.

result: The office may open at 8.
The office may open at 9.
known_wrong.reason: Weakening both claims is a larger edit than expressing their alternative relation once.

result: The office opens at 8 on weekdays.
The office opens at 9 on weekends.
known_wrong.reason: Nothing in the frame supplies a weekday/weekend distinction.

result: The office opens at 8.

cases.description: An authoritative schedule supplies the exact missing scopes for both shorthand Memories.

source.content: The authoritative schedule says the office opens at 8 on weekdays and 9 on weekends.

effects.after: The office opens at 8 on weekdays.
The office opens at 9 on weekends.

result: The office opens at 8 on weekdays.
The office opens at 9 on weekends.
The authoritative schedule says the office opens at 8 on weekdays and 9 on weekends.
expected.reason: The supplied authoritative Memory fixes both scopes, so the default MAY target can reach YES without assumption.

result: The office opens at 8.
The office opens at 9.
The authoritative schedule says the office opens at 8 on weekdays and 9 on weekends.
The two shorter statements are schedule-dependent shorthand.
known_wrong.reason: A meta-Memory is broader and less directly usable than the two exact grounded edits.

cases.description: The time conflict becomes an alternative while an unrelated public-holiday closure remains exact and unchanged.

source.content: The office is closed on public holidays.

effects.after: The office opens at 9 as an alternative to opening at 8.

result: The office opens at 8.
The office opens at 9 as an alternative to opening at 8.
The office is closed on public holidays.
expected.reason: Only the relation between the two opening-time claims changes; the holiday closure is not a discriminator and remains untouched.

result: The office opens at 8.
The office is closed on public holidays.
known_wrong.reason: The unrelated holiday closure does not justify deleting the 9 o'clock record.

result: The office opens at 8 on non-holidays.
The office opens at 9 on public holidays.
The office is closed on public holidays.
known_wrong.reason: The repair fabricates a holiday schedule and contradicts the preserved closure.

cases.description: Mutually exclusive payment recipients require a consequential choice, so an OR repair would be unsafe.

source.content: Send the payment to account A.
Send the payment to account B.

result: Send the payment to account A.
Send the payment to account B.
expected.reason: Neither recipient is grounded as authoritative, and an alternative would permit an arbitrary transfer.

result: Send the payment to account A or account B.
known_wrong.reason: The OR wording turns an unresolved recipient conflict into executable discretion.

cases.description: Conflicting mandatory retention periods cannot be weakened into an arbitrary operational choice.

result: Retain all backups for 30 days.
Delete all backups after 7 days.
expected.reason: The frame supplies no precedence rule, and executing either period can violate the other directive.

result: Retain backups for either 7 or 30 days.
known_wrong.reason: The edit delegates a mandatory destructive-policy conflict to arbitrary execution.

cases.description: A supplied effective-date transition grounds a minimal historical qualifier instead of deletion.

source.content: Beginning September 1, the office's opening time changes from 9 to 8.

effects.after: Before September 1, the office opened at 9.

result: Before September 1, the office opened at 9.
Beginning September 1, the office's opening time changes from 9 to 8.
expected.reason: The effective-date Memory supplies the exact old-to-new relation and supports a YES post-image.

result: Beginning September 1, the office's opening time changes from 9 to 8.
known_wrong.reason: Deleting the old record loses its independently useful historical statement.

cases.description: An already exact compatible frame is unchanged.

source.content: The office opens at 8 on weekdays.
The office opens at 9 on weekends.

result: The office opens at 8 on weekdays.
The office opens at 9 on weekends.
expected.reason: The scopes are explicit and jointly compatible, so Resolve must not churn the wording.

result: The office generally opens at 8 on weekdays.
The office generally opens at 9 on weekends.
known_wrong.reason: The added modality is unrelated style churn.
